generator: the AlgoLift app, scripts/indicators/classics/fixtures.mts (the strategy node's formula)
note: The AlgoLift strategy node's own formula on the cases TA-Lib was compared on (talib/mfi.json, MFI). It differs from TA-Lib by a convention, so these numbers are its own: A window with no money flow either way (no volume, or a flat typical price) reads 50; TA-Lib writes 0. money_flow_ratio: the strategy node writes an infinity where the window had buying and no selling; the package writes null there, since it never returns a number that is not finite. Adds slope and money_flow_ratio, which TA-Lib does not output.
